findings.observation: Public manifest, plans, QA and tooling are copied again from live paths after the authenticated payload was assembled, without checking each copy against its already captured entries SHA. A live edit between add() and public copy could leave the public entry disagreeing with the encrypted payload. The 05 restorer public copy also has no explicit cross-check to the existing authenticated 05 tool pin here.
findings.suggestion: Use the captured entry path/SHA for public copies and check destination SHA, or make a final independent public-vs-cold-restored SHA comparison an explicit publication requirement. This static review did not find an actual byte divergence.
